name: Legacy long-lived access token
description: The deprecated non-expiring bearer access token that the Dropbox API issued before short-lived tokens were introduced.

blockers.summary: Dropbox treats access tokens as opaque and states no format for the legacy long-lived form.
Whether existing long-lived tokens still authenticate would need a live attempt, which desk research does not make.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
